Derek Wade ran well on the first leg to record the good time of 8;4, and Yeo's 8:10 for an intermediate stage was equally noteworthy. Smith and Jarvis were our only two runners in the 'C' team, which consequently was unable to close in.

Hampshire, after a sequence of mile races, found the speed a little too great in the 880yds but still turned in a respectable 2:5.7 to finish second to Dollimore (SLH) 2:3.6. In fourth place was Jarvis (2:22.6).
Third in a personal best was Jarvis (5:2.0). Cocks was a comfortable winner of the 880 with 2:3.7, and later went out to take second spot in the quarter with 56.7.
